title: Print names on conference badges
prompt: Implement `badge_text(first, last, company)` in events/badges.py. It returns the line printed on a conference badge: the person's name, then ' - ', then the company, e.g. 'Ada Lovelace - Analytical Engines'. Names on badges must look exactly like names everywhere else in the app.
notes: people/names.py already formats names (particles like 'van' stay lower case). The lazy-wrong version uses str.title() and prints 'Ludwig Van Beethoven'.
extension: Badges for speakers get ' (speaker)' after the company. Add a `speaker=False` option.
